title: The New Century's Goddess

full_text:
Upon the threshold of the modern century stands the Muse of the new era. She carries the electric telegraph in her hand, sails upon steamships, and charts the stars with mathematical precision.

Yet her heart remains anchored in the timeless compassion of poetry, reminding mankind that intellect without love is a cold machine, and that truth must always be crowned with grace.
moral: The coming age must unite the triumphs of scientific genius with the eternal soul of poetry and love.
